title: Space Station View of Earth at Night
originalTitle: Space Station View of Earth at Night
content:
HQ Web Team

Sep 28, 2026

This nighttime view of the United States, dotted with city lights looking toward New York City (center), was taken at approximately 3:40 a.m. local time on Sept. 8, 2026, from the International Space Station as it orbited 259 miles above Earth.

Image credit: NASA/Jessica Meir
